constitutional_basis: Article XXX — never optimize the evaluator. Acceptance criteria pre-registered before bench runs, cannot be silently relaxed after seeing results.
decisive_question: Can the dual invariant (or graceful-degradation surrogate) actually be maintained when one or more paths progressively fail?

primary_acceptance_criteria.claim: System holds INV-2 (no segment flow > F_MAX) for 100% of test duration in ALL bench scenarios
primary_acceptance_criteria.measurement: Per-segment flow sensor data, sampled at 10 Hz
primary_acceptance_criteria.pass_threshold: 100% compliance (zero tolerance for INV-2 violation — patient safety)

primary_acceptance_criteria.claim: System holds P_ICP <= 22 mmHg (graceful-degradation ceiling) for 99% of test duration in mild (1/4 failure) scenario
primary_acceptance_criteria.measurement: Proximal pressure sensor, sampled at 10 Hz
primary_acceptance_criteria.pass_threshold: 99% of samples <= 22 mmHg. Allow 1% brief excursions (sensor noise, actuator delay).
primary_acceptance_criteria.honest_note: Original claim was P_ICP <= 20 mmHg strict. Simulator falsified this. Revised to 22 mmHg with explicit graceful-degradation rationale.

primary_acceptance_criteria.claim: System holds P_ICP <= 25 mmHg in adversarial (2/4 failure) scenario
primary_acceptance_criteria.measurement: Proximal pressure sensor, sampled at 10 Hz

primary_acceptance_criteria.claim: Predictor isolates segment within 60 minutes of lesion onset (k_occl=1/hr)
primary_acceptance_criteria.measurement: Isolation event timestamp vs lesion onset timestamp
primary_acceptance_criteria.pass_threshold: Mean lead time >= 30 minutes (lesion detected before catastrophic failure at 2.3 hours)

primary_acceptance_criteria.claim: System survives 24-hour test in all scenarios (no catastrophic failure, no all-segments-isolated)
System strictly superior to single-segment baseline (peak P_ICP < 60% of baseline peak in matched scenario)
primary_acceptance_criteria.measurement: Peak P_ICP across 5 seeds, multi-segment vs single-segment
primary_acceptance_criteria.pass_threshold: Multi-segment peak <= 25 mmHg, baseline peak >= 50 mmHg

secondary_acceptance_criteria.pass_threshold: Measured on V0 bench with V1 implantable components simulated
secondary_acceptance_criteria.caveat: Only measurable on V1 implantable prototype. V0 bench result is indicative, not definitive.

exploratory_metrics_NOT_acceptance_crite.rationale: Important for clinical utility but not safety-critical. Track but do not gate bench validation.
Depends on lesion timing; useful for tuning but not a pass/fail criterion.

what_constitutes_failure: Any INV-2 violation (path overload) -> FAIL, design must be revised (AC-01)
P_ICP > 25 mmHg sustained > 1 hour in any multi-segment scenario -> FAIL (AC-02, AC-03)
Predictor fails to isolate within 60 min of lesion onset -> investigate (AC-04)
Catastrophic failure (all segments isolated OR P_ICP > 40 mmHg) in any multi-segment scenario -> FAIL (AC-05)
Multi-segment peak P_ICP not significantly below baseline peak -> FAIL (AC-06)
what_constitutes_pass: AC-01 through AC-06 all met on V0 bench prototype, across 5 seeds per scenario, with no unexplained anomalies.
what_pass_does_NOT_mean: Does NOT mean clinical efficacy (bench is not patient)
Does NOT mean regulatory approval (FDA PMA still required)
Does NOT mean IP clearance (FTO analysis still required)
Does NOT promote to VALIDATED state — only to BENCH_VALIDATED, which is one step below INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED
